children: Wealthfront Corp reported first-quarter FY2027 results, with revenue of $91.9M and net income of $17.8M for the three months ended July 31, 2026. Revenue was roughly flat year‑over‑year while profit declined as the company increased investments to scale products and operations.
Revenue: $91.9M for Q1 FY2027, up from $91.1M in the year‑ago quarter (1.0%).
Net income: $17.8M for Q1 FY2027, down from $34.7M in the year‑ago quarter (49.0%).
Diluted earnings per share: Not disclosed for the quarter in Part I Items 1–2 of the filing.
Total revenue growth was modest: +1% quarter over quarter and +4% year to date, led by a 31% increase in investment advisory fees.
Cash management assets declined 4% as net deposits slowed following Federal Reserve rate cuts, while investment advisory inflows rose.
Funded clients grew 14% to 1.5M, driven by new client acquisition and cross‑product adoption.
The company increased spending on product development, general & administrative, marketing and support to scale Home Lending and platform capabilities.
Despite higher near‑term operating investments, the company remained profitable with strong Adjusted EBITDA margins.
